namedLines.line: 🍖 FEAST 📺 — Sarah opens the pantry wide: 5× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food, 1× Foraged food. Ingrid eat until the fire burns low. Somebody laughs so hard they cry. For one evening, nobody is surviving — they're just together. (−1,566 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blad
